x: The situation at the end of the war indicated the pre-eminence of those countries untouched by the conflict, especially Sweden with their great middle-distance stars Gundar Haegg and Arne Anderson, soon to fade from the scene, and the heir apparent Lennart Strand.

Friday, and after another downpour yet another favourite, the World 1,500m record holder Lennart Strand was held off by his fellow Swede Henry Eriksson; our own Bill Nankeville finished a meritorious 6th in 3.52.

The metric mile provided another storming finish with Bill Nankeville breaking clear of the field with 400 to go only to be collared close to home by Willi Slijkhuis of Holland and El Mabrouk of France in 3:47.2, the favourite Lennart Strand of Sweden not even finishing.
